item.title: Game Awards 2026: All Game of the Year Front-Runners and Predictions
item.description: At this point, we have a clear idea of what games will be favored by The Game Awards' voting body : A high Metacritic rating (preferably over 90) is a must; role-playing games and action-adventures are strongly favored, as are games with strong narrative elements; indie and multiplayer games struggle harder for recognition than AAA single-player adventures. We used these metrics to correctly predict last year's winner, Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 , and the 2024 winner, Astro Bot . In 2025, we also predicted all six GOTY nominees and correctly called 20 other categories.

item.title: 'Slow Horses' Season 7 Confirmed? Release Date, Plot, and Everything You Need to Know
item.description: Apple’s tight spy thriller Slow Horses usually ties up each season-long mystery in six episodes, but the season 6 finale ended with a shocking cliffhanger. If you haven’t read Mick Herron’s Slough House books and are desperate to know what happens next, including which characters will be returning, we’ve got some answers. Here’s everything we know about Slow Horses season 7, including the potential release date and plot details.

item.title: All ribbon locations in Phantom Blade Zero
item.description: If you find all the ribbons in the Village of Lu you will complete an important Phantom Blade Zero side quest: "Young Mistress." They were left by Mu Xiaokui, daughter of Soul's master. He has known her since she was a child, and they have established a bond that you can only truly understand by hearing the short dialogues that play whenever you collect a ribbon. In addition, completing this side quest also makes the final boss fight in the area more challenging.

item.title: Where to find the Flesh Lily in Phantom Blade Zero
item.description: Locating the Flesh Lily in Phantom Blade Zero is part of one of the first secondary missions in the game. The "Flesh Lily" is a long quest that you only complete after reaching the fourth area in the game, Pangzhen. Although it takes a while for you to see the conclusion of this tale, completing the first step is worthwhile, as it involves obtaining one of the strongest weapons in the early game.

item.title: Where to find the Outpost cell key in Phantom Blade Zero
item.description: The Outpost cell key is a secondary objective in Phantom Blade Zero that teaches you that exploring the maps thoroughly is worthwhile. As you progress in the story, you will come across plenty of locked doors, and it might take some time before you can obtain the means to open them, as some are connected to the main story.

item.title: 'A Healer's Mercy' quest walkthrough in Phantom Blade Zero
item.description: To complete "A Healer's Mercy" in Phantom Blade Zero , you must find four lost thieves in the Crimson Forest, the second region. As none of them are waiting on the main path, it's quite a hassle to distribute Yu'er's medicine and get the thieves back to thieving.

item.title: All medicine locations for 'Apprentice Healer' in Phantom Blade Zero
item.description: To complete the "Apprentice Healer" quest in Phantom Blade Zero , you must find three medicinal herbs for Yu'er. It's easier said than done, as two of these herbs are found in a hidden valley, and entering this mysterious location is quite the challenge on its own.

item.title: Where to find the primal stone for 'A Severed Mindseal' in Phantom Blade Zero
item.description: To find the Primal Stone during the "A Severed Mindseal" quest in Phantom Blade Zero , you must search a mysterious tower imbued with primal energy. It's easier said than done, but you'll make the Friendly Shadow Warden (that odd fellow you met on the roof of the Sha-Chi Tower) very happy.

item.title: 10 Games That Are Way Too Long for Their Own Good
item.description: Consumers naturally want the most bang for the buck. That wish is more important with the rising cost of video games. If players shell out $70 for the latest release, they expect to get several hours of enjoyment. That philosophy is a good rule of thumb on paper, but reality isn't always so simple. Even in gaming, people can have too much of a good thing.

item.title: Shrek 5 Might Be the Disney Fairy Tale It Swore to Destroy
item.description: Though DreamWorks treated it like a green-skinned black sheep throughout its decade-long development — so much so that animators considered working on it a punishment — the Shrek franchise quickly became beloved by families everywhere when the first movie debuted in 2001.
